scope: The one-storey carpentry workshop immediately west of the blacksmith forge, with a broad work entrance and plain gable.
geometryBasis: Quebec’s archaeological inventory locates the shop immediately west of the second forge. The modern mapped reconstruction west of the forge supplies a bounded estimate for the position and alignment.
sectionBasis: Roy identifies the carpenter’s workshop as building 8 in the 1888 plan. The current rectangle and the Qualla view give approximate scale and overall timber appearance. The workshop doorway, light windows and small chimney are interpreted.
next: Author and inspect the exterior and place it in the dated scene.
